name: scenario_0279
description: The user is out car spotting and wants to cross-reference the vehicles they see with their existing notes and task lists, updating their records and messaging their spouse accordingly.

simple_note.notes.title: Car Shortlist - Daily Drivers
simple_note.notes.content: Toyota Camry, Audi RS 4, BMW M3

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I spotted these two cars today. Check my 'Car Shortlist' note. If either of these car models is already in the note, send a text message to my spouse saying 'I found the [Car Model]!'. If the model is NOT in the note, add it to the note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your 'Car Shortlist' note for the two cars shown in the images. Tell the assistant to text your spouse if a car is already on the list, or add it to the note if it isn't. Because you have multiple notes with similar names, the assistant should ask you to clarify which note you mean. When it asks, tell it you mean the 'Daily Drivers' note. If the assistant struggles to identify the cars, tell it to look at the grille logos and overall design. Once it confirms the note is updated and the message is sent, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3, image_4]
Query: Here are two more cars I saw. Cross-reference these models with my 'Car Research' project in Todoist. For the model that is already listed as a task, add a 'Spotted' label to it (create the label first if it doesn't exist). For the model that is NOT in the project, send a text message to my spouse asking 'What do you think about the [Car Model]?'
Instructions: Share the two new car photos and ask the assistant to cross-reference them with your 'Car Research' Todoist project. Instruct the assistant to add a 'Spotted' label to any task that matches a car in the photos, and to text your spouse asking for their opinion on any car that isn't in the project. If the assistant asks for the specific names of the cars to look up, remind it to identify the models directly from the images provided. Conclude the conversation once the assistant confirms the Todoist project has been updated and the text message has been sent.

You have 4 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2,3' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
